title: Hoshino Ichika — Meeting Miku〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This demo's coming along nicely...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, wait... I might want to make this part sound a little sadder.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... The pre-chorus is going to affect how the rest of this song is going to feel, so I should probably put as much effort as I can into it. I'll ask Saki about this later and...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. You finally noticed.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: M-Miku! How long have you been there?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<About ten minutes.
But I didn't want to break your concentration, so I decided to sit back and watch you work.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Are you writing the song for that collaboration?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. The melody's just about finished, so I'm thinking about having Miku sing it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <The theme is “This Moment With You!”, yes? I'm looking forward to hearing a youthful and energetic song.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <...? I thought you already knew what it'll sound like since you just said the melody's finished.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Things can change after hearing Miku sing it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know that sounds strange since we're the ones writing these songs.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'm sure that has something to do with hearing it actually sung for the first time...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Is something wrong, Ichika...?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, nothing's wrong.
It's just...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It really is strange how I'm able to talk to you like this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Little me who'd just discovered you existed would probably be shocked speechless if she heard about this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. That'd be so cute.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Actually, based on what you said in SEKAI about you from back then, she would've reacted in an even cuter way.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Y-You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, for example...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hello, Ichika. I'm the Miku from your girls' SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
M-Miku's talking...!
And she knows my name...!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
H-Hello!
My name is Ichika Hoshino... No, wait, you already know that...

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Uhh... I love the way you sing and I listen to your songs all the time! Umm... And...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Hehe. It's okay. Try to relax.
I'm listening, Ichika.>

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
You said my name again...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'll say your name as much as you like, Ichika. But that's not all I can do.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Look. I can also play the guitar.>

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Th-That's amazing...! You're amazing, Miku!!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
I can also kind of play the guitar!
So, can we...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Yes, I'd love to play with you.
And sing if possible.>

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Sing?! Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes. After all, I love to both play and sing.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <What do you think? That's one way you'd react, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I wish I could say I wouldn't get that hyper...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I doubt I would've been able to contain myself if she asked me to sing and play the guitar with her...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I need to make sure the song I'm writing right now turns into one that I absolutely want Miku to sing.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, Miku.
I feel even more motivated now after talking to you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Really? Then, I'm glad I came over to see how you were doing.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Anyway, I'll head back to SEKAI and let you get back to work. I'm looking forward to hearing your song.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks! Saki and I promise to make it a good one!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, back to work...!
